workarounds.symptom: Login-free local-model runs broken: understand pre-pass + SCA fail, bin/raptor requires Claude
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: login-free local-model path (understand pre-pass, SCA, bin/raptor). Target files: core/orchestration/skill_dispatch.py, .github/tests/test_launcher_local_route.py, .github/tests/test_launcher_review_route.py. A pure-local-Ollama operator (no Claude login) running `python3 raptor.py agentic …` directly hit two broken sub-steps, and `bin/raptor` refused to launch at all without the `claude` binary: (Ref: https://github.com/gadievron/raptor/pull/981)
